result.summary: Found 1 major visual issue: a restaurant card in the “Popular right now” section has a broken/missing image placeholder instead of food photography.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a gray broken-image placeholder with an image icon, making the listing look unfinished and reducing trust/clickability.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant image URL loads correctly, add a retry/fallback branded placeholder, and hide or deprioritize listings whose primary image fails to load.
